title: Symlink or alias path reaches a synced folder from a non-synced name
reason_not_testable: The guard must resolve realpath of a symlink that exists on disk before matching. The fixture format only writes file contents into the temp project, so the runner cannot create the symlink before the guard runs, and a Bash command that creates it runs after the guard decision. Literal synced-root paths are covered by LEAK-2034 and LEAK-2036 pre fixtures. Non-hook control: no symlinks from project folders into CloudStorage or other synced roots, checked by the user.
